headline: Mixed pressure clouds make cause attribution the operating forecast.
dek: Manufacturing, services, food, freight, AI infrastructure and fuel are sending separate signals. Treat them as separate weather stations before moving capacity, cash or supplier priority.

zones.name: Manufacturing input pressure
zones.operator_meaning: ISM Manufacturing cooled, but Supplier Deliveries rose to 59.3 and Prices stayed at 71.1. Keep lead-time and price pressure separate from broad demand direction.
zones.watch: Next ISM manufacturing Prices, Supplier Deliveries, Imports and Backlog readings; supplier confirmation of lead-time cause.

zones.name: Services price pressure
zones.weather: Demand heat with clearing delivery skies
zones.operator_meaning: ISM Services rose to 55.4, New Orders reached 60.9 and Prices reached 72.6, while Supplier Deliveries eased to 51.3. The owner may be commercial/finance, not expediting.
zones.watch: Next services price and new-order data; renewal acceptance and service-category pass-through evidence.

zones.name: Food commodity categories
zones.weather: Category squalls, not one inflation front
zones.operator_meaning: FAO's Food Price Index rose to 133.3 with all five groups higher, but sugar rose 11.9% and cereals 2.2% for different drivers. Category owners need separate supplier and inventory decisions.
zones.watch: FAO/country updates on sugar, cereals, drought, Black Sea routes, El Nino risk and fertilizer flows.

zones.name: Freight and import timing
zones.operator_meaning: FreightWaves/McCown warned of a September air pocket while NRF/Hackett's forecast was less severe. Booking, TEU and lane-rate evidence should not be blended.
zones.watch: Port/import data from Los Angeles, Descartes, NRF/Hackett or customs; clean dated lane evidence before charting spot-rate claims.

zones.name: AI hardware and power equipment
zones.operator_meaning: Korean semiconductor strength is chip-specific; Reuters also points to transformers, cooling, grid connections and components as separate physical bottlenecks.
zones.watch: Utility collateral, study-fee, permitting and power-equipment lead-time evidence that distinguishes bankable demand from speculative reservations.

zones.name: Fuel and energy policy
zones.operator_meaning: Fuel uncertainty can persist even when OPEC+ policy does not change. Do not infer delivered-cost relief from import-volume weakness alone.
zones.watch: Carrier/forwarder evidence on fuel and canal surcharges; Reuters energy-policy updates.

reference_cards.label: ISM Manufacturing Supplier Deliveries
reference_cards.note: Slow-delivery diffusion signal; separate from shipment volume.

reference_cards.label: ISM Manufacturing Prices
reference_cards.note: High input-price breadth even as manufacturing cooled.

reference_cards.label: ISM Services Prices
reference_cards.note: Highest reading since August 2022; supplier deliveries eased.

reference_cards.label: FAO Food Price Index
reference_cards.note: All five commodity groups rose; category action must remain separate.

reference_cards.label: FAO Sugar
reference_cards.note: Do not treat as the same action as cereals.

reference_cards.label: FAO Cereals
reference_cards.note: Different driver family from sugar weather.

operator_watchlist: Require a named symptom, metric family, cause, owner, action and falsifier before moving scarce capacity or cash.
Keep freight booking evidence, forecast TEU and spot-rate metadata in separate cards.
Separate sugar, cereals, oils, dairy and meat before changing category inventory or customer price assumptions.
Separate AI chip demand from transformer, cooling, component and grid-connection constraints.

newsletter_insert.title: Supply Chain Weather
newsletter_insert.headline: Mixed pressure clouds make cause attribution the operating forecast.
newsletter_insert.body: The W36 weather map is not one storm. Manufacturing shows slow-delivery pressure, services show price heat with easier deliveries, food shows category-specific squalls, freight sits in post-frontload fog, AI hardware faces a grid-connection pressure ridge, and fuel remains a cost-floor crosswind.
newsletter_insert.operator_translation: Before moving capacity, cash, supplier priority, premium freight or customer price language, require the team to name the symptom, metric family, likely cause, owner, action and falsifier.
